summary: Session 67 frontend-only verification of the new live HomeFinanceNews section on the homepage plus /nachrichten alias routes and homepage regression. 12/12 requested checks executed. Section renders live editorial data from /api/news/nachrichten (11 editorial items, 0 aggregated), featured + 3 secondary teasers + 8 grid cards, dynamic filters, working internal links, detail page with 1276 words, CTAs, responsive 1/2/3-column grid, 0 pageerrors on all 9 routes. Two real defects found: one broken Unsplash image (data) and missing filter chips for the 'politik'/'welt' categories that exist in the feed.

ui_bugs.issue: Broken image: article 'merz-kuendigt-nach-sommerpause-zuegige-reformumsetzung-an' has image_url https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585129777188-9989f61c5f9c?w=1600&q=75 which returns HTTP 404 -> empty grey placeholder box in the homepage grid AND on the /nachrichten listing. Verified via naturalWidth==0 and curl.

FINANCE_FILTER_ORDER has no entries for 'politik' and 'welt', but the feed currently contains 1 politik + 2 welt editorial articles. Those categories therefore never get a filter chip (rendered chips: Alle, Wirtschaft, Fonds & ETFs, Europa) and their cards are unreachable via filtering, although they appear in the 'all' grid/teasers. Spec point 3 expected dynamic chips per categories present in DB.

integration_issues.issue: Minor: when a non-'all' filter is active, `filtered` is derived from `items` (not `rest`), so the featured article is re-rendered as a grid card -> duplicated headline on screen (e.g. filter 'Wirtschaft' shows 7 cards incl. the featured EU-Kommission story).

issues: No layout defect in the news section (1 column, chips wrap over 2 rows, no horizontal overflow). Pre-existing: the ProductInquiryStickyCta panel overlays a large part of the viewport on mobile and covers news cards until dismissed.

action_items: Add 'politik' and 'welt' (and any other synthesizer categories) to FINANCE_FILTER_ORDER in HomeFinanceNews.jsx, or derive chips fully dynamically with a label fallback.
Replace/validate the broken Unsplash image_url for the Merz article (404) — consider a fallback image or a HEAD-check in news_synthesizer image assignment.
Optional: base the filtered list on `rest` (or exclude the featured slug) to avoid the featured article being duplicated in the grid when a category filter is active.

Note: the slug given in the test request ('europaeische-etf-zufluesse-erreichen-neues-jahreshoch') does not exist; the actual DB slug is 'etf-zufluesse-europa-neues-jahreshoch'. The stale slug renders a 'nicht gefunden' state with 0 <h1> (SPA 200) — acceptable, but update docs/tests.
critical_code_review_comments: HomeFinanceNews.jsx creates its own axios instance at module scope; fine, but there is no timeout — a hanging /api/news/nachrichten request keeps the skeleton visible indefinitely instead of falling back to the empty state.
CATEGORY_LABEL falls back to the raw slug for unknown categories (good), but the filter list is hard-coded — see filter gap above.
Detail-slug 404 path (stale slug) renders no <h1>; consider a proper 404 heading for SEO.

rca_of_the_issue: Broken image: news_synthesizer stores a hard-coded Unsplash photo id that no longer resolves (HTTP 404) — no availability validation and no onError fallback in the card components. Missing filter chips: HomeFinanceNews.jsx uses a static FINANCE_FILTER_ORDER whitelist intersected with categories present in the feed, so synthesizer categories outside the whitelist ('politik', 'welt') can never produce a chip.
